body: the warning whistle and first-aid kit were sealed together but never opened. soot darkens the bundle; clean outlines show it was packed before the fire.
title: Warning whistle beside the spare mark

body: The notebook shows rain crossing a set of crop rows. A water bottle rests on the open page; its dry ring circles the word “downhill,” written once and then erased.
title: The rain sketch runs into the bottle ring
